text: DLSS Multi Frame Generation uses AI to generate up to five frames per rendered frame to boost FPS, powered by fifth-gen Tensor Cores
quote: Powered by GeForce RTX 50 Series and fifth-generation Tensor Cores, new DLSS Multi Frame Generation boosts FPS by using AI to generate up to five frames per rendered frame.

text: Frame generation multiplier can be adjusted dynamically to maximize smoothness across games and scenes on RTX 50 Series
quote: Dynamically adjust your multiplier to maximize smoothness across different games and scenes on GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs.

text: DLSS Super Resolution uses AI to output higher-resolution frames from a lower-resolution input to boost performance
quote: Boosts performance by using AI to output higher-resolution frames from a lower-resolution input.

text: NVIDIA app can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features and AI models, including Multi Frame Generation
quote: With the NVIDIA app you can update hundreds of games to use the latest DLSS features including Multi Frame Generation, and the newest AI models for DLSS Super Resolution, Frame Generation, and Ray Reconstruction.

text: DLSS Ray Reconstruction uses AI to generate additional pixels that improve image quality in intensive ray-traced scenes
quote: Enhances image quality by using AI to generate additional pixels for intensive ray-traced scenes.

text: DLAA provides AI-based anti-aliasing at native resolution, using DLSS Super Resolution technology
quote: Provides higher image quality with an AI-based anti-aliasing technique. DLAA uses the same Super Resolution technology developed for DLSS, constructing a more realistic, high-quality image at native resolution.

text: Neural rendering uses AI to add lifelike lighting and materials to game scenes, with per-game developer tuning
quote: Uses AI to infuse game scenes with lifelike lighting and materials on GeForce RTX™ 50 Series GPUs. Developers tune the final output for each game to bring their artistic vision to life.

text: Reflex optimizes the graphics pipeline to reduce latency for faster reactions and better aim in competitive games
quote: Reflex technologies optimize the graphics pipeline for ultimate responsiveness, providing faster target acquisition, quicker reaction times, and improved aim precision in competitive games.

text: Blackwell architecture with fourth-gen RT Cores and fifth-gen Tensor Cores enables real-time path tracing and neural rendering
quote: The NVIDIA Blackwell architecture unlocks the game-changing realism of path tracing. Experience cinematic quality visuals at unprecedented speed powered by GeForce RTX 50 Series with fourth-gen RT Cores and breakthrough neural rendering tec

text: Runs the latest AI models locally and privately on the PC
quote: Stay ahead with the latest AI models the moment they drop - running faster, smoother, and fully private on your RTX-powered PC.

text: Local AI can use the user's own files to give more personalized results
quote: running faster, smoother, and fully private on your RTX-powered PC. Add your files for smarter, more personalized results.

text: Generates images and videos locally with optimized ComfyUI workflows
quote: Generate incredible images and videos, tap into optimized ComfyUI workflows, and run the latest AI models locally in seconds

text: Project G-Assist is an on-PC AI assistant that helps tune, control, and optimize the system
quote: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune, control, and optimize your system.

text: Accelerates creative work such as video editing, 3D rendering, and graphic design
quote: GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs unlock transformative performance in video editing, 3D rendering, and graphic design.

text: Ninth-gen NVENC hardware encoder speeds up video exports
quote: Harness the power of the ninth-gen NVIDIA Encoder (NVENC) for blazing-fast video exports

text: AI-enhanced voice and video for streams and calls, including background noise removal and background replacement
quote: Take your livestreams, voice chats, and video calls to the next level with AI-enhanced voice and video. Remove distracting background noise, customize your background, and more at the touch of a button.

text: RTX Video Super Resolution and HDR enhance browser video in Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, sharpening detail and removing artifacts at up to 4K
quote: RTX Video Super Resolution and HDR uses AI to transform your videos in Chrome, Edge, or Firefox—automatically sharpening details and wiping out compression artifacts. Enjoy stunning clarity in up to 4K.

text: RTX Remix lets modders capture game assets, enhance materials with AI, and create ray-traced remasters with DLSS
quote: RTX Remix allows modders to easily capture game assets, enhance materials with AI tools, and create stunning RTX remasters with ray tracing and DLSS.

text: CUDA Toolkit provides GPU-accelerated libraries, debugging and optimization tools, a C/C++ compiler, and a runtime
quote: The toolkit includes GPU-accelerated libraries, debugging and optimization tools, a C/C++ compiler, and a runtime library.

text: CUDA Tile C++ lets developers write tile kernels in C++, built on the CUDA Tile IR specification
quote: CUDA Tile C++ is an expression of the CUDA Tile programming model in C++. It’s built on top of the CUDA Tile IR specification and allows you to write tile kernels in C++.

text: cuTile Python lets developers write CUDA tile kernels in Python
quote: cuTile Python is an expression of the CUDA Tile programming model in Python... allows you to write tile kernels in Python.

text: Nsight Compute and Nsight Systems tools help developers profile and optimize application performance
quote: NVIDIA Nsight Compute and Nsight System suite of tools designed to help developers optimize and increase performance of their applications.

text: CUDA 13.4 adds CUDA support for the Windows on Arm ecosystem
quote: CUDA 13.4 brings a host of advancements to the platform including CUDA support for the Windows on Arm ecosystem

text: CUDA containers, GPU-accelerated SDKs, and AI models are available for download from NGC
quote: CUDA containers are available to download from NGC™—along with other NVIDIA GPU-accelerated SDKs and AI models—to help accelerate your applications.

text: Curated GPU-optimized SDKs and models with performance tuning for Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch, and other inference backends
